snp5.8:1.1: “‘There are sages in the world’, said venerable Nanda,
snp5.8:1.3: that is what people say - how is this so?
snp5.8:1.4: Do they say he is a sage because he has knowledge
snp5.8:1.5: Or because of the life he leads?”
snp5.8:2.2: do the skilful say one is a sage here, Nanda,
snp5.8:2.3: whoever lives without company, not troubled,
snp5.8:2.4: not yearning, they are sages, I say.”
snp5.8:3.1: “Whoever (among) these ascetics and brahmins, said venerable Nanda,
snp5.8:3.3: say that purity is through what is seen or heard,
snp5.8:3.4: say that purity is through virtue and practices,
snp5.8:3.5: say that purity is through countless (other) ways,
snp5.8:3.6: Fortunate One, perhaps those living restrained in this way
snp5.8:3.7: have crossed over birth and old age, dear Sir?
snp5.8:3.8: I ask you, Fortunate One, please tell this to me.”
snp5.8:4.1: “Whoever (among) these ascetics and brahmins, Nanda, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.8:4.3: say that purity is through what is seen or heard,
snp5.8:4.4: say that purity is through virtue and practices,
snp5.8:4.5: say that purity is through countless (other) ways,
snp5.8:4.6: although they are living restrained in this way,
snp5.8:4.7: they have not crossed over bith and old age, I say.”
snp5.8:5.1: “Whoever (among) these ascetics and brahmins, said venerable Nanda,
snp5.8:5.3: say that purity is through what is seen or heard,
snp5.8:5.4: say that purity is through virtue and practices,
snp5.8:5.5: say that purity is through countless (other) ways,
snp5.8:5.6: if you say these sages have not crossed the flood,
snp5.8:5.7: then just who in the world of the gods and men
snp5.8:5.8: have crossed over birth and old age, dear Sir?
snp5.8:5.9: I ask you, Fortunate One, please tell this to me.”
snp5.8:6.1: “I do not say that all ascetics and brahmins, Nanda, said the Fortunate One,
snp5.8:6.3: are enveloped in birth and old age:
snp5.8:6.4: whoever here has given up (reliance on) what is seen,
snp5.8:6.5: heard, or sensed, and virtue and practices,
snp5.8:6.6: and has also given up all the countless (other) ways,
snp5.8:6.7: who, by fully knowing craving, are pollutant-free -
snp5.8:6.8: I say those men have crossed over the flood.”
snp5.8:7.1: I greatly rejoice in the great seer’s word,
snp5.8:7.2: Gotama, well-proclaimed is freedom from cleaving!
snp5.8:7.3: Whoever here has given up (reliance on) what is seen,
snp5.8:7.4: heard, or sensed, and virtue and practices,
snp5.8:7.5: and has also given up all the countless (other) ways,
snp5.8:7.6: who, by fully knowing craving, are pollutant-free -
snp5.8:7.7: I also say they have crossed over the flood.”
